title: TurnDetector
description: The end-of-turn model the semantic strategy runs on the caller's audio, beside the local VAD. livekit is the framework's on-device v1-mini detector, which covers English and Hindi among the focus languages. smart_turn is Pipecat's Smart Turn v3.2 (BSD-2), which also covers Marathi; it runs from weights the worker fetches at start, and a worker without them refuses the job. Neither covers Telugu or Kannada, so a session in a language its detector does not cover ends turns on the recognizer's own endpointing. Only the semantic strategy reads this; the catalog leaves it livekit, and smart_turn is a trial a session turns on.
